Seoul has a thriving scene for cafes. From local favourites to standout spots, here are our top picks based on the venues we track.

Map showing 7 locations

The Spots

Fritz Coffee

₩₩

A beloved Seoul roastery with a cosy industrial interior and pastries baked fresh on-site.

17 Dosan-daero 15-gil, Gangnam-gu

Insider Tip

Fritz Coffee is one of Seoul's original specialty coffee pioneers. Their Mapo-gu roastery has spawned multiple locations, but the Gangnam branch captures the same warm industrial aesthetic with consistently excellent hand-drip coffee and fresh pastries.

Zapangi

₩₩

A pink-themed cafe hidden behind a vending machine door in the backstreets of Mangwon.

400-2 Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu

Insider Tip

Zapangi went viral for its entrance — a vending machine door that swings open to reveal a dreamy pink interior. But beyond the Instagram aesthetics, the mermaid cream cakes and specialty drinks are genuinely excellent.

Cafe Extent

₩₩

Wausan-ro 21-gil, Mapo-gu

Insider Tip

Quiet cafe for coffee and work.

₩₩

Wausan-ro 10-gil, Mapo-gu
